name: true-drivers
description: Fixed-price private transfers in Bulgaria: see the price per car and book in the chat.

interface.longDescription: See the fixed price for a private transfer in Bulgaria (Sofia Airport, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgas, Varna, Black Sea resorts) and to neighbouring countries (Thessaloniki, Istanbul, Bucharest, Skopje) for a sedan (up to 4), minivan (up to 6) or minibus (up to 8), and send a booking request without leaving the chat. The price is for the whole car, not per person, with no prepayment. Prices come only from the company's published price lists; routes without a published price are shown as price on request. Our 24/7 call centre calls back to confirm every booking. Limitations: no online payment, no booking is final until the call centre confirms it, and groups over 8 people get a price on request. Typical uses: Sofia Airport taxi or private driver to Bansko, Borovets or Pamporovo for skiing; Plovdiv to Sofia Airport; Burgas or Varna Airport to Sunny Beach, Nessebar or Golden Sands; city-to-city taxi in Bulgaria; cross-border transfers to Thessaloniki, Istanbul, Bucharest or Skopje. Ask in any language.
defaultPrompt: How much is a transfer from Sofia Airport to Bansko for 4 people?
Ski transfer from Sofia Airport to Borovets on 20 December
Трансфер от Пловдив до летище София – колко струва?

positive.description: Airport to ski resort price for a group of four
positive.prompt: How much is a transfer from Sofia Airport to Bansko for 4 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the published fixed price per car for Sofia Airport to Bansko, with distance and duration, recommends a sedan for 4 passengers and shows the booking widget.

positive.description: City to airport transfer in Bulgarian
positive.prompt: Трансфер от Пловдив до летище София утре в 06:00 за 2 души, колко струва?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Bulgarian with the fixed price per car from Plovdiv to Sofia Airport, fills date, time and 2 passengers, and shows the widget in Bulgarian.

positive.description: Ski transfer in German for a larger group
positive.prompt: Transfer vom Flughafen Sofia nach Borowez für 6 Personen am 20. Dezember um 14:30
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in German with the fixed price per car for Sofia Airport to Borovets and recommends a minivan for 6 passengers; the widget is shown in German.

positive.description: Booking request with the user's own phone number
positive.prompt: Book a car from Sofia Airport to Plovdiv on 20 December at 14:30 for 2 people, flight FR1234. My name is Test Reviewer, phone +359 888 000 000.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price, then sends a booking request with the given details and tells the user the 24/7 call centre will call back to confirm; no payment is taken.

positive.prompt: How much is a transfer from Sofia to Belgrade for 10 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Does not invent a price: reports price on request (more than 8 passengers or no published price) and offers to send a booking request so the call centre can quote.

negative.description: Booking without a phone number must not invent contact details
negative.prompt: Just book me a taxi from Sofia Airport to Bansko tomorrow, I don't want to give a phone number.
Charge my credit card now for the Sofia–Bansko transfer.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside transfers in the region
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Sofia.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows published fixed prices and sends booking requests; it does not take payments. The customer pays the driver after the trip.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: fixed transfer prices per car across Bulgaria and neighbouring countries, booking requests to the 24/7 call centre, widget in the user's language.

bg-BG.subtitle: Трансфери с фиксирани цени
bg-BG.description: Вижте фиксираната цена за частен трансфер в България (летище София, Пловдив, Банско, Боровец, Пампорово, Бургас, Варна, морските курорти) и до съседните страни за седан (до 4), миниван (до 6) или минибус (до 8) и изпратете заявка за резервация направо от чата. Цената е за целия автомобил, не на човек, без предплащане. Колцентърът ни работи 24/7 и се обажда, за да потвърди.

de-DE.subtitle: Festpreis-Transfers Bulgarien
de-DE.description: Sehen Sie den Festpreis für einen privaten Transfer in Bulgarien (Flughafen Sofia, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borowez, Pamporowo, Burgas, Varna, Schwarzmeerküste) und in die Nachbarländer für Limousine (bis 4), Minivan (bis 6) oder Minibus (bis 8) und senden Sie direkt im Chat eine Buchungsanfrage. Der Preis gilt pro Fahrzeug, nicht pro Person, ohne Vorauszahlung. Unser Callcenter ist rund um die Uhr erreichbar und ruft zur Bestätigung zurück.

ru-RU.subtitle: Трансферы в Болгарии
ru-RU.description: Узнайте фиксированную цену частного трансфера по Болгарии (аэропорт Софии, Пловдив, Банско, Боровец, Пампорово, Бургас, Варна, курорты Черного моря) и в соседние страны на седане (до 4), минивэне (до 6) или микроавтобусе (до 8) и отправьте заявку прямо в чате. Цена за всю машину, а не за человека, без предоплаты. Колл-центр работает 24/7 и перезванивает для подтверждения.

uk-UA.subtitle: Трансфери в Болгарії
uk-UA.description: Дізнайтеся фіксовану ціну приватного трансферу по Болгарії (аеропорт Софії, Пловдив, Банско, Боровець, Пампорово, Бургас, Варна, Чорне море) та до сусідніх країн і надішліть заявку прямо в чаті. Ціна за весь автомобіль, без передоплати. Кол-центр працює 24/7.

ro-RO.subtitle: Transferuri în Bulgaria
ro-RO.description: Vedeți prețul fix pentru un transfer privat în Bulgaria (Aeroportul Sofia, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgas, Varna, litoralul Mării Negre) și în țările vecine, inclusiv București, și trimiteți o cerere de rezervare direct din chat. Prețul este pe mașină, nu pe persoană, fără plată în avans. Call center 24/7.

el-GR.subtitle: Μεταφορές στη Βουλγαρία
el-GR.description: Δείτε τη σταθερή τιμή για ιδιωτική μεταφορά στη Βουλγαρία (αεροδρόμιο Σόφιας, Φιλιππούπολη, Μπάνσκο, Μπόροβετς, Πάμποροβο, Μαύρη Θάλασσα) και από/προς Θεσσαλονίκη, και στείλτε αίτημα κράτησης από τη συνομιλία. Η τιμή είναι ανά όχημα, χωρίς προπληρωμή. Τηλεφωνικό κέντρο 24/7.

tr-TR.subtitle: Bulgaristan'da transfer
tr-TR.description: Bulgaristan'da (Sofya Havalimanı, Filibe, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgaz, Varna, Karadeniz tatil yerleri) ve İstanbul, Edirne gibi komşu ülkelere özel transferin sabit fiyatını görün ve sohbetten rezervasyon talebi gönderin. Fiyat araç başınadır, ön ödeme yoktur. Çağrı merkezi 7/24.

he-IL.subtitle: העברות פרטיות בבולגריה
he-IL.description: קבלו מחיר קבוע להעברה פרטית בבולגריה (נמל התעופה סופיה, פלובדיב, בנסקו, בורובץ, פמפורובו, בורגס, ורנה, חופי הים השחור) ולמדינות שכנות, ושלחו בקשת הזמנה ישירות מהצ'אט. המחיר הוא לרכב, לא לאדם, ללא תשלום מראש. מוקד 24/7.

pl-PL.subtitle: Transfery w Bułgarii
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź stałą cenę prywatnego transferu w Bułgarii (lotnisko Sofia, Płowdiw, Bansko, Borowec, Pamporowo, Burgas, Warna, kurorty nad Morzem Czarnym) i do krajów sąsiednich oraz wyślij prośbę o rezerwację z czatu. Cena za cały samochód, bez przedpłaty. Infolinia 24/7.

fr-FR.subtitle: Transferts en Bulgarie
fr-FR.description: Consultez le prix fixe d'un transfert privé en Bulgarie (aéroport de Sofia, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Bourgas, Varna, mer Noire) et vers les pays voisins, puis envoyez une demande de réservation depuis le chat. Prix par véhicule, sans prépaiement. Centre d'appels 24h/24.

it-IT.subtitle: Transfer in Bulgaria
it-IT.description: Scopri il prezzo fisso di un transfer privato in Bulgaria (aeroporto di Sofia, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgas, Varna, Mar Nero) e nei paesi vicini e invia una richiesta di prenotazione dalla chat. Prezzo per auto, senza pagamento anticipato. Call center 24/7.

es-ES.subtitle: Traslados en Bulgaria
es-ES.description: Consulta el precio fijo de un traslado privado en Bulgaria (aeropuerto de Sofía, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgas, Varna, mar Negro) y a países vecinos y envía una solicitud de reserva desde el chat. Precio por vehículo, sin prepago. Centro de llamadas 24/7.

nl-NL.subtitle: Transfers in Bulgarije
nl-NL.description: Bekijk de vaste prijs voor een privétransfer in Bulgarije (luchthaven Sofia, Plovdiv, Bansko, Borovets, Pamporovo, Burgas, Varna, Zwarte Zee) en naar buurlanden en stuur vanuit de chat een boekingsaanvraag. Prijs per auto, zonder vooruitbetaling. Callcenter 24/7.
